# enlace_connector

> Deploy Python functions as authenticated MCP connectors on an enlace platform


## Pages in this subsection

- [enlace_connector](enlace_connector.html.md): &#96;enlace_connector&#96; — deploy Python functions as authenticated MCP connectors.
- [enlace_connector.auth](enlace_connector.auth.html.md): Auth configuration for connectors — the resource-server side of MCP OAuth.
- [enlace_connector.connector](enlace_connector.connector.html.md): Define a connector once, run it anywhere — stdio (local) or HTTP (hosted).
- [enlace_connector.deploy](enlace_connector.deploy.html.md): Generate everything needed to deploy a connector on an enlace platform.
- [enlace_connector.preflight](enlace_connector.preflight.html.md): Preflight/verify checks — is the target platform able to keep a connector &#42;alive&#42;?
- [enlace_connector.scaffold](enlace_connector.scaffold.html.md): Generate the enlace app directory that serves a connector.
